section_audit.title: Your mission
section_audit.purpose: Know the learning target, try the clock question, and keep observations separate from explanations.

section_audit.title: Notice the evidence
section_audit.purpose: Inspect the bus display, compare first impressions, and use the engineering note to identify what is actually supported.

section_audit.title: See how it works
section_audit.purpose: Trace the bus estimate, colour rule and driver override as three separate decisions.

section_audit.title: Compare the cases
section_audit.purpose: Compare human control, a written instruction, a trained model and a device whose mechanism is unknown.

section_audit.title: Words that unlock the idea
section_audit.purpose: Use the vocabulary to explain a decision, then challenge an unsupported claim about robots.

section_audit.title: Follow a worked example
section_audit.purpose: Follow the bus and umbrella worked cases. Predict a step before revealing the explanation.

section_audit.title: Find and repair a mistake
section_audit.purpose: Repair claims based on a robot body, a screen or a correct answer; identify the missing mechanism evidence.

section_audit.title: Practise together
section_audit.purpose: Practise the photo-library explanation with support, then explain the deciding evidence in your own words.

section_audit.title: Run the investigation
section_audit.purpose: Investigate the supplied devices. Keep predictions, evidence, conclusions and unresolved questions distinct.

section_audit.title: Build your understanding
section_audit.purpose: Move from recalling a word to tracing, diagnosing, transferring and defending an explanation.

section_audit.title: Connect your project
section_audit.purpose: Apply the evidence habit to the Helpful Classroom Sorter and retain a labelled project decision.

section_audit.title: Show what you know
section_audit.purpose: Use a genuinely new case for independent evidence. If the six devices were discussed earlier, treat them as practice; the reserved greenhouse task is in Section 14.

section_audit.title: Study a complete case
section_audit.purpose: Revisit the six-device worked example for extra explanation. This is supported practice, not a fresh assessment.

section_audit.title: Try a new case independently
section_audit.purpose: Attempt the reserved greenhouse case before feedback. The other examples below are additional practice, not repeated fresh assessments.

section_audit.title: Your lesson route
section_audit.purpose: Use this map to navigate the week and connect the goals to the evidence you will produce.

section_audit.title: Finish and return
section_audit.purpose: Explain the idea without notes, name a remaining question, and plan a later return check.

section_audit.title: Supported practice, repair and portfolio
section_audit.purpose: Use supported questions, hints and feedback to improve an explanation, then keep your completed work.

section_audit.title: Visual concept journey
section_audit.purpose: Read each graphic, explain one labelled step, and connect its evidence to your project.

section_audit.title: AI or Not?
section_audit.purpose: Prepare the resources, check readiness and choose a realistic teaching schedule before starting the explanation.

section_audit.title: Explain the mechanism
section_audit.purpose: Teach the information path, distinguish the three mechanisms, and model how evidence supports a limited conclusion.

section_audit.title: Demonstrate and guide practice
section_audit.purpose: Use the board sequence and dialogue to model reasoning, reduce help, and check every learner before discussion.

section_audit.title: Run the weekly evidence lab
section_audit.purpose: Run the evidence investigation, capture actual observations and choose support from the first reasoning error.

section_audit.title: Assess and explain the answers
section_audit.purpose: Use the keys after the relevant attempts. Previously discussed cases are practice; the reserved independent transfer question is the greenhouse case.

section_audit.title: Connect and extend learning
section_audit.purpose: Connect the explanation to the project, plan extensions and revisit prerequisites where needed.

section_audit.title: Prepare, teach and assess
section_audit.purpose: Use this preparation summary alongside the detailed sections; it is a checklist, not a replacement lesson.

section_audit.title: Use feedback, labs and repair paths
section_audit.purpose: Use feedback, review links and portfolios purposefully. Coding guidance applies when a later lesson contains a lab.

section_audit.title: Visual concept journey
section_audit.purpose: Show one graphic at a time, ask for a prediction, then use the labelled trace and teacher reasoning to discuss it.

section_audit.title: Recall and choose your starting point
section_audit.purpose: Record your first explanation before opening notes, then show any correction separately.

section_audit.title: Practise with fading help
section_audit.purpose: Use the photo-library completion task. Keep a trace of the step you completed and any help you used.

section_audit.title: Individual reasoning check
section_audit.purpose: Challenge the proposed claim using the supplied facts before discussing it with a partner.

section_audit.title: Independent transfer case
section_audit.purpose: Write one first attempt at the reserved greenhouse case before feedback; Section W4 refers to this same case.

section_audit.title: Your learning target
section_audit.purpose: Use the bus target to explain which component makes each decision and which evidence supports the classification.

section_audit.title: Solve the given case
section_audit.purpose: Classify the six supplied devices and support each conclusion with mechanism evidence.

section_audit.title: Check a changed case
section_audit.purpose: Apply the distinction to the toy, photo app and talking clock, and explain each classification.

section_audit.title: Design a revealing test
section_audit.purpose: Design a changed or missing-information case and keep the expected result separate from what you observe.

section_audit.title: Project checkpoint
section_audit.purpose: Justify a project decision and retain the evidence that would let another person check it.

section_audit.title: Self check
section_audit.purpose: Assess explanation, evidence, transfer and limits separately; attach the work behind your judgement.

section_audit.title: Transfer practice from the original programme
section_audit.purpose: Use the original bus question as transfer practice. A previously discussed case is not fresh assessment evidence.

section_audit.title: W1 Separate observations from explanations
section_audit.purpose: Separate what is visible at the door from the question you still need answered about its mechanism.

section_audit.title: W2 Complete the photo library explanation
section_audit.purpose: Classify the photo-library decisions and name the records needed to diagnose a misplaced picture.

section_audit.title: W3 Challenge an unsupported conclusion
section_audit.purpose: Offer plausible alternatives for the vacuum turn, then identify evidence that could distinguish them.

section_audit.title: W4 Investigate a new hybrid system
section_audit.purpose: This is the same greenhouse task as the independent transfer section. Reuse that recorded first attempt.

section_audit.title: W5 Design an evidence card
section_audit.purpose: Design one product with two mechanisms, then state one supported and one unsupported claim.

section_audit.title: Feedback, return check and learning record
section_audit.purpose: Record the feedback, the first step you repaired and a different case to revisit after a delay.

section_audit.title: Pictorial case practice: AI or Not?
section_audit.purpose: Explain the umbrella picture and predict a changed boundary using the supplied facts.

section_audit.title: Project portfolio milestone
section_audit.purpose: Keep the sorter milestone, input, deciding step, result and limitation together in the project record.

section_audit.title: Supported practice and learning evidence
section_audit.purpose: Use the supported questions once, compare with feedback after attempting them, and record what you repaired.

section_audit.title: Visual concept journey
section_audit.purpose: Explain each picture using its labels and evidence, then record a relevant limit.
